prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. ONE complete isolated full-body transparent 2D character. Image1 is the APPROVED FOR INTERNAL CONTINUATION front-idle master of THIS variant: exact identity/face/hair/actual skull-to-torso/torso-to-limbs proportions/standing pose/outfit/equipment/rendering authority. Image2 is ONLY this SAME variant's original rendering/equipment detail reference; do NOT copy its fighting crouch, raised swords or camera. Never use a different variant, generic adult or generic big-head chibi. This request only rotates the SAME relaxed idle master into a new camera yaw.
Rotate the ENTIRE figure 45 degrees to face SCREEN RIGHT, a FRONT three-quarter view. BOTH brown eyes visible (far eye narrower), nose points right, front breastplate remains partly visible; shoulders/pelvis/both planted feet rotate together. NOT a side profile and NOT a rear view.
POSE: same comfortable basic STANDING IDLE as image1, both soles planted, near-straight relaxed knees, weight balanced, feet about shoulder width in world space (projected separation naturally narrows when rotated). Level shoulders, arms naturally hanging at hips with only relaxed elbow bend. Exactly TWO arms/hands and TWO weapons. RIGHT hand holds original LONGSWORD DOWNWARD beside right leg, LEFT hand holds SHORT angular DAGGER DOWNWARD beside left thigh. Rotate their same physical lowered pose, do NOT impose the same screen-space diagonal on every view. No fighting crouch, raised weapons, chest crossing, walking/attack or deep knee bend. Natural continuous arm/wrist/palm, finger-wrapped true handles and opposing thumb, no gripping blades/guards. Maintain the same head size relative to chest/limbs as image1 and same youthful male age and composed facial impression; do not lengthen the body or inflate the hair.
IDENTITY: golden blond layered hair, brown eyes, silver plate armor, blue scarf and SHORT lowered hood ending around upper back (NO long cape), blue waistcloth, brown belts/pouches/trousers. Anatomical RIGHT crescent pauldron and silver plated shin, LEFT blue cloth boot with metal protectors. Longsword preserves blue diagonal blade inlays, silver wing-shaped guard, gold center and CLOSED RING knuckle guard; dagger stays SHORT and angular. Do not swap sides, mirror, add emblems/straps/weapons or copy a different person's gear. Use natural occlusion and minimally infer back/side structure of the SAME hood and armor.
FRAMING: complete hair, both soles, all weapon tips/guards with roughly 10% clear transparent safety margins all round, no crop. Connected character/equipment is one composition. No background, ground shadow, effects, text, panels, labels or watermark.
RENDERING: precisely preserve image1 and image2's soft warm-brown outlines, gentle modeled metal/cloth with subdued midtones, slightly longer medium-SD anatomy of variant4. Do not merge variant1 and4 rendering. This is a single idle view, not an animation sheet or illustration-proportion redesign.
inputRoles: this variant NEW FRONT IDLE: pose/identity/proportions/rendering master
same variant original style/equipment details only; old combat pose excluded
stage: after this variant front actual-image internal review
